verdict.rationale: Netlify's own site states that any deploy can be rolled back in one click, which matches both parts of the story: any previous version, and a single action. The support is one marketing line, though, with no detailed documentation and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on rollback mechanics and scope (e.g. how far back deploys are retained, behavior of functions and env vars on rollback), and independent or community corroboration of one-click rollback working in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click

citations.quote: Roll back any deploy in one click
